design: Staged five-method comparison;192 existing internal+288 prospective full/external; not a new blind480 experiment

primary_endpoints.network_task_coverage_pct: Mean over source-rounds with latest delivered birth>=0 and t-birth+1<=4; fixed100sources and all1344round obligations for every controller, including unsensed slots.
primary_endpoints.source_P5_pct: 5th percentile (linear interpolation) of100 per-source task coverages, one value per network seed/cell.

primary_family.unit: Independent network seed, n12; average the eight prespecified cells with equal weights within each seed
primary_family.contrasts: Complete JLC-R versus each of the four controls, two primary endpoints
primary_family.test: two-sided paired t test df11, Holm8 at0.05; report signed absolute changes and nominal95% paired t intervals
primary_family.success_interpretation: Do not require all metrics/cells significant. State which corrected comparisons support a positive effect, their absolute size, and all tradeoffs.
primary_family.sensitivity: 4096 exhaustive paired sign flips per contrast, separately corrected Holm8; sensitivity does not replace failed primary tests.
primary_family.zero_variance: Record undefined t inference, Holm input1, exact sign-flip sensitivity and deterministic observed difference separately; never assign p0 or claim estimated variance certainty.

secondary_families.correction: Holm64, paired within cell, n12; secondary results cannot rescue a failed primary aggregate claim

endpoints: Jain index of per-source coverages (all-zero vector explicitly reported as0 with degeneracy flag)
Mean AoI minutes with initial no-delivery age=t+1
secondary_families.correction: Holm72; AoI gain sign is baseline minus full JLC-R

reporting: All8cells and all5methods, complete per-seed records
Nominal95% intervals identified as non-simultaneous; adjusted decisions separately
No pseudoreplication using nodes, packets or time samples as independent networks
Historical480/agriculture864 evidence keeps true implementation identities

failure_missing_rerun.missing_pairs: Stop confirmatory inference until resolved; do not silently drop seeds or impute favorable values. If irrecoverable, report protocol deviation and exact missingness.

development_separation.author_parameter_vs_adaptation: See external method audits; no original system replication claimed

causal_information: Historical observations only; identical warm-up and input processes. LANTERN uses prior-macro rates; EADCM uses common past-only forecast. No future energy credit.
randomness: Frozen keyed_uniform(seed,t,sender,receiver,packet.sequence,attempt); route/action differences can change which keys are consumed. Same exogenous field, not forced identical outcomes on different paths. LANTERN exploration/Trickle/control use separate SeedSequence/key namespaces.
workflow: verify_lock.py is read-only. rc2_matrix.py requires authorization.json matching this exact protocol hash and refuses existing run directories.
